issue.title: bug: acp in zed: acp protocol flow error after first 'hello' message from user to agent
issue.body:
@TimeToBuildBob : 

This is a follow up on https://github.com/gptme/gptme/issues/1268, 
a next step in making gptme-acp work inside zed.


1. after upgrade:
```bash
[user0@work4 ~]$ uv tool install --force --upgrade "git+https://github.com/gptme/gptme.git@master[acp]"
Installed 1 package in 12ms
 ~ gptme==0.31.0 (from git+https://github.com/gptme/gptme.git@2f390bdc5e60b15c44e8dca1e288686353700c11)
 ```

2. when the users sends a
    'hello' prompt to gptme-acp via zed console

3. zed reports error in zed acp console:
```log
‘TextContentBlock’ object has no attribute ‘get’
```

4. zed reports error in zed.log:
```log
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: 2026-02-18 07:49:18,216 - root - ERROR - Background task failed
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: Traceback (most recent call last):
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: File "/home/user0/.local/share/uv/tools/gptme/lib/python3.13/site-packages/acp/task/supervisor.py", line 51, in _on_done
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: task.result()
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: ~~~~~~~~~~~^^
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: File "/home/user0/.local/share/uv/tools/gptme/lib/python3.13/site-packages/acp/task/dispatcher.py", line 81, in runner
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: result = await self._request_runner(message)
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: File "/home/user0/.local/share/uv/tools/gptme/lib/python3.13/site-packages/acp/connection.py", line 237, in _run_request
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: raise err from None
2026-02-18T07:49:18-05:00 WARN  [agent_servers::acp] agent stderr: acp.exceptions.RequestError: Internal error
```
 
5. attached integration test reports 2 new errors (post-1268):
* session_id change
* acp/sdk protocol flow
 
[verify_gptme.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25391383/verify_gptme.log)
[verify_gptme.py](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25391382/verify_gptme.py)

6. perhaps it is a good time now to write your own integration tests for acp based on `verify_gptme.py`?

expected: gptme-acp replies to the first prompt normally.
defect: The first session/prompt fails with ACP `Internal error`; the client shows `'TextContentBlock' object has no attribute 'get'`.
Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/gptme/gptme/pull/1291 (commit c30f86e4cf4e9ecd67053acc429382f845e6ed6a), followed by https://github.com/gptme/gptme/pull/1293 and https://github.com/gptme/gptme/pull/1300. Newer agent-client-protocol SDKs deliver prompt content as Pydantic models (TextContentBlock) instead of dicts, but gptme/acp/adapter.py acp_content_to_gptme_message called `c.get("type")` on each block, raising AttributeError that the SDK turned into 'Internal error' on the very first prompt (agent.py also used dict access on RequestPermissionResponse and an invalid stop_reason 'error'). PR #1291 accepts both dicts and Pydantic objects; #1293 and #1300 fix the next failures on the same path ('No model loaded') by propagating ContextVars into the executor thread and re-setting the default model/tools in each ACP handler. All three ship in v0.32.0; the pinned revision contains them.
